data.name: Skånefrö
data.description: Skånefrö is a family-owned Swedish seed company founded in 1928 in Tommarp/Hammenhög, producing agricultural, grass and turf seeds as its core business with ~40 employees and revenue over 300M SEK. As an adjacent activity, it operates a biochar production line using Pyreg pyrolysis units on agricultural residues, park/garden waste, seaweed and sludge, supplying district heating to Tommarp and Hammenhög and selling EBC-certified biochar for agriculture and landscaping, partnered with Ecoera for carbon removal certification.
